problem: Find the average value of the function $f(x,y)=4{x}^{2}-2xy$ on the region $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le 3}.$
worked_solution:
First, notice that 

$$
\text{Area}(D)=2\cdot 3=6.
$$

Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{\text{ave}} & =\frac{1}{\text{Area}(D)}\,{∬}_{D}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{∬}_{D}(4{x}^{2}-2xy)\,\text{d}A \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{3}(4{x}^{2}-2xy)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{\int }_{0}^{2}[4{x}^{2}y-x{y}^{2}]_{y=0}^{y=3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{\int }_{0}^{2}(12{x}^{2}-9x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{[4{x}^{3}-\frac{9{x}^{2}}{2}]}_{x=0}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}(4\cdot {2}^{3}-18\cdot 1) \\  & =\frac{14}{6} \\  & =\frac{7}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
